homicides <- read.csv(here("data", "homicide-data.csv"))
str(homicides)
## 'data.frame':    52179 obs. of  12 variables:
##  $ uid          : chr  "Alb-000001" "Alb-000002" "Alb-000003" "Alb-000004" ...
##  $ reported_date: int  20100504 20100216 20100601 20100101 20100102 20100126 20100127 20100127 20100130 20100210 ...
##  $ victim_last  : chr  "GARCIA" "MONTOYA" "SATTERFIELD" "MENDIOLA" ...
##  $ victim_first : chr  "JUAN" "CAMERON" "VIVIANA" "CARLOS" ...
##  $ victim_race  : chr  "Hispanic" "Hispanic" "White" "Hispanic" ...
##  $ victim_age   : chr  "78" "17" "15" "32" ...
##  $ victim_sex   : chr  "Male" "Male" "Female" "Male" ...
##  $ city         : chr  "Albuquerque" "Albuquerque" "Albuquerque" "Albuquerque" ...
##  $ state        : chr  "NM" "NM" "NM" "NM" ...
##  $ lat          : num  35.1 35.1 35.1 35.1 35.1 ...
##  $ lon          : num  -107 -107 -107 -107 -107 ...
##  $ disposition  : chr  "Closed without arrest" "Closed by arrest" "Closed without arrest" "Closed by arrest" ...
homicides <- homicides |> 
  mutate( city = str_to_lower(city))

Omaha_homicides <- homicides |> 
  filter(city == "omaha")

Omaha_homicides <- Omaha_homicides |> 
  mutate(outcome = if_else(disposition == "Closed by arrest", "Solved", "Unsolved"))
omaha_map <- county_subdivisions(county = "Douglas", state = "Nebraska") 

ggplot() + 
  geom_sf(data = omaha_map)

omaha_homicides_2 <- st_as_sf(Omaha_homicides, coords = c("lon", "lat")) |> 
  st_set_crs(4326)

ggplot() +
  geom_sf(data = omaha_map, color = "lightgray") +
  geom_sf(data = omaha_homicides_2, aes(color = fct_lump(victim_race, n = 3))) +
  facet_wrap(~ outcome,
             nrow = 2) +
   scale_color_viridis(name = "Race", discrete = TRUE) +
  ggtitle("Omaha Area Homicides") +
  theme_linedraw(ink = "gray28")
